traditional: No classical doctrine: Uranus is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Action meets disruption. Impulsive, risk-taking, rebellious energy, with impatience and a pull toward technology. Psychologically the square is inner tension to integrate: Accident-proneness, a temper that goes off like a shot, and unpredictable tactics that either win big or backfire fast. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.waxing: Crisis of action: take conscious hold and build a durable form for drive against disruption, or be thrown off course.
cyclic.waning: Crisis of meaning: break down the drive/disruption form that has outlived its purpose and reorient toward the next cycle.

business: Friction in this area. Innovative and fast; the cost is recklessness and volatility.
shadow: Anger and recklessness collides with instability for its own sake; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: Friction builds toward a forced adjustment.
arcSeparating: The crisis passes; what was restructured settles.

readerCopy.summary: One abrupt move triggers a chain reaction before anyone agrees on what should replace the old plan.
readerCopy.body: One abrupt move triggers a chain reaction before anyone agrees on what should replace the old plan. Mars square Uranus can make disruption outrun coordination, so a walkout, shutdown, technical change, or public confrontation creates new problems faster than the original one can be solved. The impulse to break the pattern may be right. The timing can still be reckless. Contain the fallout, identify what absolutely has to change, and test the replacement on the smallest scale that still produces useful information.
